name: development-claude-plugin
description: Plugin family for projects that ARE Claude Code plugins. Ships a test harness (/development-claude-plugin:test) and a maintenance dispatcher (a topic plugin: composes alongside the language plugin via /development:maintenance). Validators: plugin.json <-> marketplace.json version sync (claude-plugin-version-sync) and SKILL.md/agent frontmatter contract (claude-plugin-skill-validator). Further validators (orphaned references, directory structure) follow.
